correctness.rationale: Every overlap-free source prefix is cubefree, hence its curling digit is 2 precisely for a square suffix and 1 otherwise. Prefix heredity makes the terminal-overlap recursion exhaustive. Independently compiled and ran a standalone C++17 implementation of the complete first-symbol-normalized ternary search: exactly 1680 valid length-83 prefixes, 2016 length-84, zero length-85; at 84 exactly two transform images with normalized fibers 1344 and 672. Grouping normalized length-84 words yields 672 distinct parents, each with three terminal extensions. Multiplication by three first-letter choices gives 5040 length-83 words, 6048 length-84, fibers 4032/2016; the 2016 terminal words use all three source letters, so the S3 orbit counts are 1008 total, 672/336 by fiber. Direct finite recursion, not simulation, proves the full finite statement. The source normal-form T and final equal-last-pair digit test are consistent with the terminal recurrence.
